summary.result: Although uncertainties exist in the results, the estimated soil moisture and ESC based on the SMDA were comparable to the measurements.
summary.background: In this study, we developed the Soil Moisture Data Assimilation (SMDA) scheme to extract Effective Soil Characteristics-ESC (Sand, Silt, Clay %) from MODerate resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) products.
summary.method: Several numerical experiments were conducted to test the performance of SMDA at the study sites under the synthetic and field validation conditions.
